title: skills(pm-dispatch): clause-② cards build at the default tier and are gated by the contract review at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (#16905)
body:
Fixes #16905

**Governed surface — draft only.** `.claude/skills/**` is governed (AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14): this PR stays draft, carries `needs-user-decision`, a 「维护者速读」 comment (5588349195, edited in place after the patch round), and review requests to `os-zhuang` and `hotlong`; no seat approves, undrafts, queues or arms auto-merge. `SKILL.md` is itself a 强制条款① surface, so this PR was **built at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`** (dispatch claim comment 5588071161) — the change cannot exempt its own landing.

**Patch round (head `e1edc4196`)** after the tier contract review (comment 5588464964, CHANGES REQUIRED); body refreshed for this head after the re-review (5588691266) read a copy predating the 16:47Z body write — the head itself is unchanged: the director seat **widened the file surface** to `references/contract-review.md`, `references/core-rules.md` and `references/lanes/cli.md`, so the `references/**` copies of the build mandate are rewritten here, line-neutral; the :639 consequence is stated below; the :675 tripwire has an actor and a frozen comparison arm. `origin/main` (`70f7d6d73`) merged in as a merge commit (`b5be3f049`, plain `Merge remote-tracking branch`, no trailers, no content of its own), no conflicts, no overlap with these files; the two content commits are `bd26a0839` and `e1edc4196`, and reverting those two is the rollback recipe.

## What changes

Four files under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/`, **11 insertions / 11 deletions**, every file keeps its line count under its own shrink-only ratchet ceiling: `SKILL.md` 811 → 811, `references/contract-review.md` 60 → 60, `references/core-rules.md` 150 → 150, `references/lanes/cli.md` 29 → 29; every rewritten line is within the 120-byte budget (widths in the table). 强制条款② goes from "clause-② cards are built AND reviewed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`" to "built at the default judgment tier, reviewed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`", and every `references/**` sentence that still described a build/dispatch mandate now says the mandate governs the review tier only. Untouched: 强制条款① (SKILL.md main file, the decision-frame copy, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`); the carrier discipline (`needs:contract-review` on card and PR, cleared only by a posted verdict at tier; SKILL.md :646-647 byte-identical); the tier fuse `references/contract-review.md:60`; `references/lanes/spec.md`'s dispatch criteria; the four-axis frame block (SKILL.md :734-752, md5 `22f2339f0acb64cdb50c7adc9db681c3` on merge-base, on head, and on current `origin/main`).

## Where each deleted or replaced piece of content lives now

- **SKILL.md:514 「一律契约复审档」** → the new rule in the same line (default-tier build, at-tier review); the mechanism is the pre-existing 「降档施工的补偿控制 = 复核席跑契约复审档」 at :512-513, which now covers clause ② too.
- **SKILL.md:514 「拉回已声明契约按常规档」** → :517 「拉回已声明契约不触它」: narrowing is not clause ② (also `lanes/spec.md:19` 「收窄仍是语义面,不触条款②」), so it carries neither the mandated review nor a tier mandate — "按常规档" is now every card's default and distinguishes nothing.
- **SKILL.md:522 first half 「卡面对条款②的复述仍是条款②」** → :517 「卡面复述仍是条款②」.
- **SKILL.md:522 second half 「额度耗尽豁免及其 `needs:contract-review` 补偿一并及于它」** → genuinely redundant: the exemption floor is the default judgment tier (:526 「⛔ 不再往下」), now the clause-② build tier anyway; the carrier hangs on every `Clause-②: yes` card regardless of tier (:646-647); the review never downgrades (`contract-review.md:60`). No guarantee is lost.
- **SKILL.md:525 「条款②工作」 → 「条款②复核」**: the ceiling tier is reserved for the clause-② review, no longer the build.
- **SKILL.md:640 「且派发档位低于契约复审档」** → deleted as a dead predicate (with every clause-② build below the ceiling it is always true, and the old line would read "clause-② PRs never enqueue"); the exit it always had — the 2026-08-16 gate text 「派发席职责止于:卡上记一行认定、挂 needs:contract-review、停手;⛔ 禁止自查放行」 — is now written on the gate line itself as 「无席内契约复审档 PASS 在案 ⛔ 禁止入队」 (PASS 在案 as defined by `contract-review.md:41` 落地前检①). **Consequence, stated for the maintainer to rule on knowingly:** the rewritten gate makes an in-seat `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS on record the **sole exit for every path-limb hit** (diff touching `packages/spec/src/**`), including `Clause-②: no` spec-lane PRs and at-tier builds — stricter than #16912's recorded current practice (#16899 / #16901 enqueued on `check-clause2-carriers --pair` exit 0 without a PASS) and stricter than #16912's own suggested wording, consistent with `lanes/spec.md:33` 「条款②路径肢照命中,入队前仍过契约复核」 and with 「按更严的一条行动」. If that is not intended, :639 needs 「判定 `yes`」 inserted before the PASS clause. **#16912 remains open; this PR does not decide it.**
- **SKILL.md:675 (round 1 text 「…基线待测;实质高于达档施工 ⇒ 条款②回退」)** → rewritten with an actor and a comparison arm that exists after the change: the seat writing the round report (报告席) records the default-tier clause-② review FAIL rate in the 复审清单 (`contract-review.md:40`); the comparison arm is the **historical at-tier-built FAIL rate frozen before this change** (改制前达档史值 — today **n = 1**: 1 FAIL / 1 at-tier-built clause-② card, objectui#8583 / PR #8601; a sample of one, ⛔ not a baseline); the report seat carries the **n alongside the rate** on both arms so a card is never read as a threshold breach on 1 vs 1; exceeding it produces a **decision card to the maintainer**, who judges the n and decides the revert — never a seat act.
- **contract-review.md:10 「只定派发档位的保守方向」 → 「只定是否必过契约复审档复核的保守方向」**: the declaration's purpose is now the review mandate, not the dispatch tier; 「按设计临时 … ⛔ 非终审」 kept.
- **contract-review.md:13 「直接锁契约复审档」 → 「锁契约复审档复核」**; **:15 「派契约复审档」 → 「挂标走契约复审档复核」**: the mechanical floor and the "unsure ⇒ yes" rule now lock/route the review, not the build; 「⛔ 不建全量分类学与 claim 时决策程序」 kept.
- **core-rules.md:113 「协议语义面与契约变更卡恒走契约复审档」 → 「语义面卡恒契约复审档施工,契约变更卡恒其复核」**: 条款① (build at tier) and 条款② (review at tier) separated; 「协议」 dropped for the byte budget — 「语义面卡」 is the same term the line's own context (dispatch call, per-card tier) already scopes.
- **core-rules.md:124 「档位不足的契约卡」 → 「无达档复核 PASS 的契约卡」**: after the change the only tier that can be insufficient for a contract card is the review seat's (the fuse), so the enqueue bar names the missing PASS rather than an unspecified tier.
- **lanes/cli.md:18 「条款②从卡内容判且优先于它」 → 「条款②从卡内容判,只定复核档不定施工档」**: clause ② no longer overrides the path-derived build floor; it sets the review tier.

## The tripwire (ruling item 3)

SKILL.md :675 as above. No new script, label or state; the record lands in the round report's 复审清单, the revert is a decision-box card.

## Mechanism hypotheses (verified on `origin/main` @ `0939ba008`)

- **H1 holds.** `references/contract-review.md:60`: 「契约复核 ⛔ 不适用额度耗尽豁免降档:豁免对象是派发,复核正为补偿低档派发而存在。」 and `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` `MANDATORY_TIER_GLOBS` docblock: "references-only surfaces carry NO path mandate any more (opus execution, compensated by the skill-face review at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER)", recording the 2026-08-20 ruling 「fable 当审计师用,不当施工队用」. Both sanction low-tier build + at-tier review.
- **H2 holds.** Edit regions do not overlap the frame block; md5 identical; `check:skill-frame-sync` and `check:skill-frame-freshness` exit 0.
- **H3 holds.** `references/lanes/skills.md:20` 「条款②闸门照现行」 points at the enqueue gate (kept); 「pm-dispatch 根恒契约复审档」 is 条款①. Not edited.
- **H4 holds for the code, not for the prose.** `deriveTier` encodes clause ① globs only. The script's `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` docblock ("must be dispatched at"), `MANDATORY_TIER_GLOBS` docblock ("is also CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER") and the `tierLines` strings printed on every `--tier` run ("is fable-mandatory too") still describe a BUILD-tier mandate. `scripts/pm/**` stays out of surface; filed as **#16914** (`finding`, `Blocked-by:` this card), whose body was re-scoped in this round to the script prose only now that the `references/**` sites are rewritten in this PR; #16914 remains open.
